description:
## What

Wire DANE into pkix-chain's verify_tls_server (PKIX-fmtv.11) via the layered control model from Mark 2026-05-12.

## Cargo feature

`pkix-chain/Cargo.toml`:

```toml
[features]
default = ["dane"]
dane = ["dep:pkix-dane", "dep:pkix-dane-resolver"]
```

When `dane` is enabled (default), verify_tls_server attempts DANE. When disabled, verify_tls_server is pure-PKIX behavior.

## Runtime config

verify_tls_server gains a config struct (or builder) carrying DANE state:

- Resolver override (default: built-in pkix-dane-resolver with sensible config)
- Enable/disable toggle (runtime override of the compile-time default)
- Failure-mode policy (depends on .4)

Conceptual API:

```rust
verify_tls_server(chain, anchors, hostname, port, now, &verifier, &rev_checker)
    // -> DANE-default if compile-time enabled, runtime can override

verify_tls_server_with_config(chain, anchors, hostname, port, now, &verifier, &rev_checker, &dane_config)
    // -> explicit config for callers who care
```

OR builder pattern:

```rust
TlsServerVerifier::new(anchors)
    .with_resolver(custom_resolver)
    .with_dane_off()
    .verify(chain, hostname, port, now, ...)
```

Builder shape vs args shape is a sub-decision; file separately if needed.

## DANE flow inside verify_tls_server

1. If `dane` feature off OR runtime config dane=false: pure PKIX path (current behavior).
2. Else:
   a. Resolve TLSA records via configured resolver.
   b. If DNS/DNSSEC fails: apply failure-mode policy (.4 decision).
   c. If TLSA records absent: pure PKIX path (treat as no constraint).
   d. If TLSA records present: dispatch by usage:
      - DANE-EE (usage 3): match leaf hash; if match, return Ok bypassing chain validation.
      - DANE-TA (usage 2): synthesize TrustAnchor; add to anchor set; run verify_chain.
      - PKIX-TA (usage 0): run verify_chain; assert chain transits through TLSA-named CA.
      - PKIX-EE (usage 1): run verify_chain; assert leaf matches TLSA.
      - Multiple records: try in policy-defined order.

## Depends on

- PKIX-j32w.1 (pkix-dane)
- PKIX-j32w.2 (pkix-dane-resolver)
- PKIX-fmtv.11 (verify_tls_server foundation)
- PKIX-j32w.4 (failure-mode decision)
- PKIX-j32w.5 (DNS config source decision)

## Acceptance

- [ ] Cargo feature `dane` exists, default-on
- [ ] verify_tls_server attempts DANE when feature on and runtime config allows
- [ ] verify_tls_server is pure-PKIX when feature off
- [ ] All four DANE usages exercised in tests
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry flagging the dep tree growth
- [ ] AGENTS.md crate inventory updated to reflect pkix-chain's new shape

## Stub status

Future work. Blocks on .1 + .2 + PKIX-fmtv.11. Decision-children .4 + .5 needed before this lands.
